content: @Image 1 is the main character — attractive, confident European businesswoman in her early 30s. Emerald-green eyes, long lashes, winged eyeliner, refined facial features, fair skin, soft natural makeup, chestnut-brown wavy hair. Maintain exact face, body, tattoos, and outfit consistency across all shots.Outfit: tailored executive suit (black/charcoal/navy), blazer with rolled sleeves revealing elegant black-and-gray floral/geometric tattoo sleeves. Minimal luxury accessories. Premium pointed heels. Professional high-fashion look.@Image 2 is the vehicle — deep metallic burgundy Koenigsegg Jesko with exposed carbon fiber, aggressive aero body, large rear wing, black forged wheels, brown quilted leather interior. One car only, doors closed, all details consistent.@Image 3 is the environment — ultra-modern European financial district at golden hour. Glass skyscrapers, clean boulevards, reflective surfaces, soft sun haze. Continuous cinematic world.Shot 1 (0:00–0:02) Camera on skyscraper facade in @Image 2, slow vertical descent begins.Shot 2 (0:02–0:06) Drone accelerates down glass tower, city reflections stretch, street level emerges.Shot 3 (0:06–0:09) @Image 1 crosses sunlit financial district crosswalk, calm confident walk.Shot 4 (0:09–0:12) Tracking beside and behind her at walking speed, wind in hair, reflections moving across glass music, no score. 4K ultra-realistic cinematic style, sharp focus, natural skin texture, stable identity, no distortion or flicker. Luxury corporate fashion film aesthetic. Continuous single-take feel.
